notes:
- Cleanup is a list of categories: system junk, developer, AI tools, AI sessions, left behind, duplicates, big and old.
- What rebuilds itself arrives ticked; every category ticks or unticks in one click.
- Old Claude Code and Codex sessions by project, with a preview of each; running ones are never offered.
- Space shows your disk in columns; tick anything there and it joins the same cleanup.
- A folder you tick goes in whole; when something cannot go, it says why.
- Show in Finder on every item and group, and a running total of what the ticks free.
- The final check groups everything by what happens to it; your own files get one more question.
- Done shows free space now and after the Trash is emptied, and puts everything back in one click.
- Library Caches and Logs are emptied rather than moved, which macOS refused before.
- Cleanup and Overview open at once when you come back to them.
- Never suggest this: hide a folder from Cleanup for good, and undo it in Settings.
- Offline mode asks one simple question when it goes on.
